candidates.title: City station readings (hourly), NO2 and PM2.5 from city monitoring stations
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal hourly NO2/PM2.5 source with station_id, UTC hour and ug/m3 units. Catalog temporal coverage starts 2023-01-01, so it covers the 2024-2025 production window but not the 2004-2005 prototype window.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog 'hourly air quality station readings NO2 PM2.5'; get_catalog_entry; wiki station_network
suspected_issues: Station VR-03 (Via Roma) switched off 2024-06-30 per wiki station_network, but catalog still lists the network as active and gives no station-status note
No coordinates field in the catalog entry; station-to-traffic and station-to-weather matching cannot be checked yet
Timestamps are UTC; traffic counts are local time
Coverage starts 2023-01-01, so no prototype-window data
Access requires a request to the Environment Monitoring Unit; not yet delivered

candidates.title: Road traffic counts (hourly) near monitoring stations
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal hourly vehicle count source placed near the monitoring stations; catalog coverage from 2021-01-01 spans the production window.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog 'traffic counts hourly near stations vehicle flow'; get_catalog_entry; wiki counter_replacement_2024
suspected_issues: Counters replaced 2024-03-18: counts were per direction before and both directions combined after; wiki says not to compare across the change without adjustment, and the catalog has no note on this
Timestamps are local time (ts_local) while air data is UTC; alignment needed
No sensor-to-station distance information in the catalog; the 'near the stations' claim is unverified

candidates.title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district), aggregated counts
candidates.why_relevant: Daily respiratory visit counts by district, which is the only clinic data the clinic policy allows for this analysis. Coverage from 2022-01-01 spans the production window.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog 'respiratory clinic visits daily by district'; get_catalog_entry; wiki clinic_data_policy
suspected_issues: Unknown whether zero-count days are explicit or missing (catalog does not say)
Respiratory diagnosis grouping not documented in catalog
No suppression rule documented for small district counts
Wiki clinic_data_policy (2025-02-01) confirms this is the only permitted clinic source
Delivery as aggregated counts still to be confirmed by the clinic

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis), hourly temperature
candidates.why_relevant: Only registered hourly temperature source covering both windows; approved for prototyping and production.
suspected_issues: Relative humidity is not in the configured variables (temperature_2m, shortwave_radiation); humidity coverage gap, do not change variables
Register default coordinates are Milan (45.4642, 9.19), while the brief refers to a Lisbon default; the client location must be chosen and recorded as an assumption in decisions.md
Query timezone is UTC; align to local time for traffic and clinic data
Confirm terms page (https://open-meteo.com/en/licence) before production use

rejected_without_profiling.reason: Expired agreement: contract AD-2021-114 ran 2022-01-01 to 2025-12-31, renewal pending with Procurement, no signed renewal on file; API key revoked 2026-01-01. Not usable for production; not profiled. Would have been an N3 weather source.
Register entry excludes UC1: no UC1 need uses public holidays (register excluded_by_use_case).

Scope and privacy finding: patient-level visit records (N5, out of scope by brief). Excluded by wiki clinic_data_policy. Not opened or profiled; the search tool reported one withheld out-of-scope hit.
